description: This file defines a web scraper class 'FarmhouseDelivery' for extracting recipe information from the 'farmhousedelivery' website, handling multiple layout styles for ingredients and instructions, and extracting title, image, and other details.

classes.name: FarmhouseDelivery
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from farmhousedelivery website, supporting multiple layout styles for ingredients and instructions.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the domain URL for the farmhousedelivery recipes.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts the recipe title from the webpage.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Raises exception indicating total time info is not provided by the website.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts the list of ingredients, supporting two different layout styles.

methods.name: _instructions_list
methods.description: Cached property that extracts instructions as a list, supporting two layout styles.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Joins instructions list into a single string separated by newlines.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Extracts the image URL from the recipe page.
